Select molecule ChEMBL ID, molecule name, maximum phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Filter by document ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5244223. Use LEFT JOIN compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES, allowing nulls. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID. Do not deduplicate rows.
